[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fix the confirmed xprompt VCS-tag cache leak[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]vcs-cache[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]vcs-cache - give the caches derived from workspace-provider metadata a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]real invalidation entry point and restore them on teardown, so a test [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that fakes plugin metadata stops poisoning every later test in its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]worker.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Build a global-state leak detector and inventory every leak in[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]the suite[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]leak-detector[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]leak-detector - build an opt-in pytest plugin that snapshots [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]process-global state around every test, distinguishes cache warming from[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]poisoning, and delivers a full-suite inventory artifact of every leak. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Reports only; blocks nothing.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stop the flake gate from flagging node IDs that no longer [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]exist[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]stale-nodes[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]stale-nodes - bead sase-j5. Make the reproducible-flake gate skip or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]separately report recorded node IDs absent from the collected suite, so [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a renamed test stops manufacturing pressure to bump the baseline cutoff.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fix every inventoried leak and root-cause the residual flakes[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]fix-leaks[dim] · [dim][/dim]after vcs-cache, leak-detector[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]fix-leaks - fix every poisoning leak in the inventory by mechanism, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]deterministically reproduce and fix the bead-cluster and plan-approval [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]nodes whose cause is not yet known, and flip the leak detector into a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]blocking gate so the class cannot recur.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Shrink the baseline, run the exit criteria, and close the [/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]beads[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]retire[dim] · [dim][/dim]after vcs-cache, leak-detector, stale-nodes, fix-leaks[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]retire - remove every fixed node from the flake baseline, run the four [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exit criteria non-vacuously on the combined tree, and close sase-j4, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sase-j5, sase-j6, sase-ct, and sase-iy.5 on that evidence.[/#D7D7AF]
